title: bromus madritensis var. rubens
intro: Bromus madritensis var. rubens, commonly known as Red Brome, is a perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Red Brome are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Red Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
